correctionSummary.reason: Final system release closing the correctness-remediation and visual-modernization program for The Missing Dance.
corrections: C2C2-TASK01 Observation coding. The OK / ? coding conflated whether an observation is established with whether it remains diagnostically important; those two judgements are now separated in the learner editions and the key.
C2C2-PACE01 Declared class-period route. The undeclared 110-minute core route is now an explicitly declared multi-period route rather than a hidden overrun.
C2C2-T02 Rubric system. The three-level rubric was replaced by the common quick rubric plus the full 4/3/2/1 analytic rubric.
C2C2-ACC01 Accessible workload. Accessible Tasks 5 and 6 were too close to the full Student workload and gained targeted scaffolding without changing the accepted response space.
C2C2-T01 Teacher structure is validated against the corrected functional set rather than a fixed page count.
C2C2-VIS01, VIS02 and VIS03 Poricidal-cone cutaway, vibration-to-release pathway and the four-setting monitored trial panel modernized through the shared visual layer.
unchanged: Curriculum wording beyond the corrections listed above, scientific conclusions, task order, response controls and persistence identities, presentation CSS, layout overrides, fixed Letter page geometry and learner-field sizing are unchanged from the owner-approved corrective and visually modernized state. The release conversion itself changed lifecycle metadata and records only.
